title: Fluidstack signs 15-year, 245 MW lease at Hut 8's River Bend ($7.0B)

sources.quote: Base-Term Contract Value: Total contract value of $7.0 billion over a 15-year base lease term, inclusive of a 3.0% annual base rent escalator.

explain: Fluidstack signed a 15-year, $7 billion lease for 245 megawatts at Hut 8's River Bend campus in Louisiana; Google backstops the lease payments. The capacity is widely tied to Anthropic, which works with Fluidstack.
